title: Digital Literacy Coaching to Support Smoking Cessation in Rural Communities: Increasing Digital Engagement and Access
official: Digital Literacy Coaching to Support Smoking Cessation in Rural Communities: Increasing Digital Engagement and Access (IDEA 2.0)
summary: We will conduct a prospective, randomized trial of 602 adults who smoke in the rural Midwest. Participants will be randomized to either: (Control) mailed computer/internet access resources, or (Intervention) computer/internet access resources plus the COACH intervention.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. A Mayo Clinic Rochester (MCR) or Mayo Clinic Health System (MCHS) patient.
2. Aged 18 years or older.
3. Can read and speak English
4. Has a MN, WI, or IA address currently or on the date of most recent clinic visit.
5. Rural resident based on RUCA codes 4-10 based on zip code of current/last known address.
6. Has access to a phone of any type (e.g., landline, smartphone, iPad) and email. If participant does not have regular access to a phone or email, we will send them a guide to help find computers and internet access in your area. We will also offer to lend them an iPad with a free data connection plan. If they do not have an email account, the study staff can help them set one up.

(8) Current cigarette smoking, defined as having smoked one or more cigarettes (even a puff) in the past 7 days.

(9) Digital access and literacy challenges, defined as:

1. no device and/or internet access based on the Digital Health Screening Tool (DEST) measure50 or Federal Communications Commission (FCC)51 data on broadband internet availability in their zip code, AND
2. DEST digital literacy item response of "somewhat comfortable", "a little comfortable", or "not at all comfortable".

   * Note: If a participant does not have regular access to an internet-connected device, we will send them a guide to help find computers and internet access in their area. We will also offer to lend them an iPad with a free data connection plan.

     (10) Considering or willing to make an attempt to quit smoking cigarettes within the next 6 months.

     (11) Willing to sign informed consent form. (12) Willing to complete baseline and follow-up surveys.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Anyone not meeting all inclusion criteria will be excluded.
2. Was previously enrolled in the original IDEA smoking cessation trial27at Mayo Clinic.
3. Does not have valid contact information, i.e., no usable physical address, email address, or phone number.
4. Has used any EBCT in the past 30 days (e.g., pharmacotherapy or counseling. Other types of nicotine/tobacco products including e-cigarettes are allowed).
